reviews.text: Stay away from this place. There are many other better veterinary clinics. Money is their main goal not your pet's health
Stay away from this place. There are only interested in money. They don't care if you're dog or animal is suffering.
Fantastic and personal care, ideally we never have to go back but thank you for caring for our pup while we were there
The staff are great with my cats; they do a fantastic job when they're sick and when they need grooming.
I very very comfortable bringing my pet here. They care.

They have need a Godsend Helping my cat Titan, who has been newly diagnosed with diabetes. They take the time to educate me on how to give insulin, take blood samples, etc. They actually care for the cat and show concern, and my bill ends up being smaller than estimated because of my situation. Dr.  Badri has even delivered important food to my home when I couldn't get downtown to pick it up. Above and beyond 10 *

i’ll change it to 5 stars when they bring back grooming services. This place was the best for grooming im sad they got rid of it. Now my dog has to adjust somewhere else 😒 Overall great staff and helpers for other services! BRING BACK GROOMING! …

Their care is felt from the heart; as if my apollo and jewel were their own pets - family members.  They treat what is needed and give excellent advice also.  They are my go to people.  All staff is warm and caring.

I have a min pin named Dobby, he was attacked and bit by a much LARGER dog.
Before I begin..my previous baby was also their patient and ive been their customer over 10 yrs...
Dr.Badri team took such great care of my baby and after 2 weeks he is running around as if nothing happened.
words cant describe the care and love they put in their work...Dr.Badri himself is an angel sent from god...Mr.Babak and the rest of the team are LOVELY. The receptions are SO NICE and helpfull....this clinic CARES FOR YOUR PETS HEALTH......ive been to diffent clinics for small issues and the first things they ask is MONEY...this clinic will sit down ...examin your baby...explain options AND WORK WITH YOU...BECAUSE THEY ARE HUMAN...my pet is my life and i will NEVER EVER trust any doctors except Dr.Badri team...I strongly ask ALL you pet owners to come to this clinic ...
NO MATTER WHERE YOU LIVE...COME TO THIS CLINIC...IM A HUGE ANIMAL LOVER AND I PROMISE YOU WILL NOT REGRET IT
❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

Dr. Badri and his team are knowledgeable and caring.
This is the one place in this big city that I feel the entire team are in it for the love of animals and not for your money.
My 11-year old dog had bad teeth, but due to his age, syncope episodes, and breathing issue I wasn't really comfortable to let him go through anesthesia for the process. I could not trust any of clinics I talked to as they seemed more concerned about getting me to sign their risk form and charging me big bucks. Then I was introduced to Dr. Badri who listened to my concerns with care, and talked to me very honestly about pros and cons. After consulting I felt comfortable to trust him with the procedure and I am so glad I did. The procedure took long but went very well and along with the Ozone therapy Zippo received after the procedure, the results are unbelievable. Here isal a photo and video of my dog the next night after 7 teeth extracted and the rest cleaned. He's running and prancing like a puppy only one day after the surgery and I have to calm him down to prevent any complications 😅
I can't thank Toronto Central Animal Clinic- Dr. Badri and his team enough.

I can’t recommend Toronto Central Animal Clinic enough. They are the primary vet for our two cats, and time and time again, the entire team has proven to be exceptionally caring, patient, and thorough.
They’ve helped us through a few stressful moments recently—including a scary incident a month ago when our cat Daisy swallowed a rubber band, where Dr. Shaikh took the extra time to carefully evaluate her and catch subtle details in her chest X-rays that others might have missed.

Most recently, we brought Daisy in with Dr. Michael for an FIC (urinary) flare-up. Our other cat was diagnosed with FIC earlier this year at a different clinic, but she was never given a truly comprehensive treatment plan.

Walking away from Toronto Central Animal Clinic today with Daisy felt completely different. Dr. Michael took the time to do a full, thorough assessment and sent us home with a clear, immediate pain management and stress-relief protocol, along with actionable guidance on how to support her long-term.

A special shoutout as well to the incredible vet tech team—every single tech we’ve interacted with has been so gentle, sweet, and patient with Daisy.

It is such a relief as a pet owner to have a clinic you fully trust. You can tell the entire staff genuinely cares about the animals, and they never rush the process. We know our girls are always in the best possible hands here!

I’m truly grateful to Toronto Central Animal Clinic for the wonderful care they provide to my beloved Mickey. ❤️🐾 A special thank you to Dr. Mohammed, Dr. Shaikh, and Dr. Badri for their kindness, compassion, and dedication. The entire team is caring, professional, and always makes us feel supported. I truly appreciate everything you do for Mickey and highly recommend this clinic! 🐱❤️
I found the staff and the vets here to be very attentive, thorough, accommodating, and transparent. Can’t recommend them enough :)

Dr. Jabali is very caring and compassionate toward my two Boxers. He genuinely wants to see them healthy and takes the time to provide the best care possible. He always listens to my concerns, explains everything clearly, and treats my dogs with kindness and patience.

Best vet I’ve ever had. They’ve saved my 15 + year-old kitty, Brenda, by going above and beyond with state of the art procedures & facilities. And my other kitty, Bijan, is now doing great despite his severe sinus issues (Persian flat nose, you know).

I thought I already left a review last year when we first came but I regret that I did not. I cannot recccomend this clinic highly enough. So far, I have had the pleasure of interacting with all three vets who are warm, patient and informative. This clinic does not try to drain you of every last penny like most of the corporate clinics in Toronto-they tell you exactly what you need and are transparent about every cost. The front desk is very helpful as well. I hope I do not have to see them again but if I do-they are the best vet in the city. Example (from first visit which sums them up in a nutshell) I brought my medicated shampoo from home from which I had some left-they looked at the ingredients and said theirs is similar but slightly better...ANY OTHER VET would not even have looked at your shampoo and would have just hard sold you theirs and if you wouldn't get it they would guilt you...I 100% recommend this clinic and it deserves FIVE STARS. Thank You Toronto Central Team!

I've been going to this clinic for over 15 years now. The owner is incredibly kind and knowledgeable. He has an fantastic team that has recently expanded. At our last visit we met with a vet that specialized in dermatology issues, which was exactly what we needed. They are also reasonably priced and try to reduce costs when possible. I highly recommend them.

Hi I highly recommend to go to this place the doctor with gentle with my little princess and the price is can be affordable for me because I'm on ODSP I was there again on Tuesday the 23rd 20 26th my little girl is 14 years old now the doctor told me she has bad teeth are she's going to have to get them pulled and I do trust him she has her UTI infection again and she's on medication doing okay for now resting her little knee keep popping out of the sockenl  but she too old to have surgery she's not that bad yet  arthritis  she also has bronchitis  the doctor recommend that I to put her on a puffer , she is recent district is a good place I love it thank you Dr, Team june 23 2006

Dr. Badri kept my husband's cat Tiffany alive for 26 years with home visits, she was actually in the Toronto Sun for her longevity...
He is now keeping our aging Bengal cat Tony alive with great love and tenderness, and affordable fees.
There are few Doctors in the world like him, the city is so lucky.

I have been using the veterinary services at Toronto Animal clinic for over 15 years to treat 4 cats and 3 dogs. (Now down to 2 cat and 2 dogs!). I have found the clinic lead by Dr. Badri to be compassionate, and fair. I can call anytime with a question or prescription refill and solve my issue quickly. I am grateful for the care and attention my pets receive by a friendly and caring staff. I would definitely recommend this clinic. Additionally, the staff is open to discussion to chart the pet’s health care plan and prognosis. Happy clients here!!

I don't go to this vet but from the conversation i just with whoever answered the phone was awful. Impatient and lacking empathy would be how i describe it.

If that is any indication of their beside manner i'd not recommend it.

My experience with your team has always been exceptional. The staff are truly wonderful, and Eddy is always so well cared for. I feel completely comfortable knowing he is in such capable and caring hands.
I have been coming to this clinic for years. Dr. Badri is the best cat doctor in the world!

We bring our pets to TCA clinic over the years. Wait time for the appointment is not too long, and they are available even on a short notice. Doctors and staff are knowledgeable and provide expert advises. We are very happy with TCA services over the years.

I brought my dog in for swollen lymph nodes. Within days, I was told he had aggressive cancer, but after that there was no clear follow-up plan, no written explanation, no reliable callbacks, and apparently no notes for staff to reference when I called. I had to phone and email repeatedly just to understand what was happening.

The visit itself felt disorganized. My dog was handed between multiple people, and I kept having to explain or clarify what we were there for. I was also offered ozone treatment multiple times despite saying I was not interested, and I was left to decipher estimates myself instead of being clearly guided through what was necessary.

The lack of coordination has been unacceptable. Days after requesting a referral and follow-up plan, I still had no clarity. I ended up contacting oncology clinics myself with only the lab results because I could not get proper direction from this clinic.

What bothers me most is the lack of care after the diagnosis. They took my money, told me my dog has cancer, and then left me waiting for days without meaningful follow through. It should not take multiple business days to coordinate a follow-up appointment or explain expectations to a client whose pet has just been diagnosed with cancer.

If a clinic can take me in quickly, charge over $1,000, diagnose cancer the next day, and then leave me chasing them for basic communication, that does not feel like patient-centered care. It feels like taking on cases quickly without enough follow-through.

I wish I had read more reviews before coming here. If your pet needs serious care, I would strongly recommend looking elsewhere.

I would recommend this Vet to anyone. I have had 4 dogs and I have been happily taking my precious dogs to this Vet. I am a senior and this  veterinary has been so supportive if I didn’t have the full amount of money. I was able to pay on a payment schedule. Please know the Doctors will treat your loved pets with care, as if your loved dog was their own. Please try this Vet place just once, you will know your pet is in good hands. The clinic is clean, reasonable, money wise and a safe place.

Dr. Ahmed Badri always provides exceptional service. His receptionists and junior vets are also very cordial. I've been going to this clinic since 1999 when I had my first cat. Not once has Dr. Badri faltered. He's a man of integrity, honesty and commitment, always looking out for the welfare of animals. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone considering a vet!
Thank you from the bottom of my heart for your 27 years of service to my animals - BooBoo (who passed away, and you respectfully cremated), and now my beloved Hazel.

Sangita

Dr Badri has been our vet for over 15 years. He is outstanding in his expertise, honesty and compassion. His staff are amazing. We are so thankful to have him and his team’s knowledge and compassion caring for our pets over the years.  We highly recommend Toronto Central Animal Clinic !!!!
Great place to take your pet. With all the conglomerates buying up independent vet clinics, this gem has stayed individually owned and operated.

I’ve had a great experience with this veterinary clinic. I really appreciate that they follow up to check how my pet is doing after visits—it shows they truly care.

They also take the time to call and clearly explain test results, which gives me peace of mind and helps me understand my pet’s health better.

Additionally, they are very flexible with scheduling and always try to accommodate my availability, which makes a big difference.

Highly recommended for their professionalism, communication, and genuine care for pets.

This is the best vet clinic I have ever been to. The vets are so knowledgeable, and wonderful with animals. Appointments are always on time, and there is never much of a wait to book an appointment. Plus, whenever I have had an emergency and a pet needed same-day care, they have always accommodated this--even if it means a vet coming in a bit early or staying a bit late. I couldn't recommend TCAC more.
The best doctor and staff

Dr. Badri and staff have been caring for our pets for 30+ years. He is consistently professional and kind. When it came time to let our seniors go he came to our house so they could leave peacefully in comfortable surroundings I highly recommend Toronto Central Animal
This is our 10yr old Eevee, a retired racing Greyhound, who has been in his care since she came to us. Greyhounds have their own particular issues, one of them is very bad teeth another is a clotting disorder. They can bleed excessively if not treated correctly. Dr. B. has removed 16!!! of Eevee’s teeth and she’s here to tell the tale
Thanks TO Central Animal
Carly is great with my senior pup who loves her spa day and always looks amazing!

Not sure who my doctor was today or the vet tech but seriously everyone was fantastic from me making my initial phone call appointment right until I left. I recently got a new kitten riddled with fleas and may I say for being downtown Toronto they have the best prices and are very kind and compassionate about animals. I will definitely be coming back here and will be recommending to anyone who is looking for a new vet downtown. Great job everyone, plus they are a private clinic (which I prefer compared to corporate). Thanks again everyone!
The dr are amazing I always have 3 come in and treat my Lyla and Jaxon and my dogs love them

Caring, understanding and friendly staff that don't push products and treatments to where you feel bad for turning down the offer.  I've been perfectly satisfied with them and continue to go there even though we no longer live neaeby

Brought my dog here never had issues. then one time for my insurance, they needed a routine check up (no injections nothing).

Then my dog died about 3 days later. She had rapidly declining health out of the blue. Autopsy couldn’t really clarify a reason.

Hoping that this isn’t a place desperate to collect money from end of life services…. i would stay away.

Clinic is very fast and easy to make an appointment and bring your fur baby in .Visits, test and prescriptions are priced very reasonable and affordable. Staff is very friendly. After each appointment they call to check in on your fur baby , to make sure they are feeling better or asking for an update. It's never really busy when I go in , and there usually isn't a long or waiting period to wait.  My CoCo enjoys the treats also.

I truly felt it was important to share the very positive experience I had at this clinic. The day I brought Mocha in was an emergency, and it was an extremely stressful and worrying situation for me. From the moment we arrived, however, the professionalism, calmness, and genuine care shown by the team immediately reassured me that Mocha was in the right place.
With Babak’s help and coordination, the admission process was handled quickly and efficiently. The medical team acted without delay, performed a thorough examination, and recommended the necessary tests. What stood out the most was not only their medical competence, but the way they carefully explained every step to me with patience and clarity. They made sure I understood what was happening and why, which made a very difficult moment much easier to handle.
It was clear that Mocha was not treated as just another case, but as a valued patient deserving real attention and compassion. The team consistently monitored her condition, kept me informed about any updates, and answered all of my questions respectfully and thoughtfully. When you are worried about your pet, this level of communication and empathy truly makes a difference.
The clinic itself was clean, well-organized, and professionally managed. Everything ran smoothly, and there was a strong sense of coordination among the staff. The overall experience reflected both high medical standards and genuine care for animals.
I sincerely appreciate Babak and the entire team for their prompt response, expertise, and compassionate approach. When it comes to the health of a beloved member of your family, trust is everything — and I genuinely felt that trust here.
I would absolutely return in the future with confidence and highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for dedicated and professional veterinary care.
The staff are kind and helpful.
Great atmosphere at the clinic. My pet was comfortable around the staff and Doctor
The entire team is very accommodating and easy to deal with.

Easily the WORST experience I have ever had at a vet. If you wish to receive genuine care for your beloved pet, please I beg you to go anywhere but here. Horrible communication, unsafe animal handling practices, overall very negligent.

We have been taking our cat here for years. They are amazing and have saved his life on a few occasions. They are honest in their suggested treatments and we appreciate it.

This is a pic of him getting his laser treatment to treat his chronic pain!

This vet clinic was AMAZING!! I had an emergency and they were very thorough and attentive and didn't push or pressure me into any decision-making. We worked as a team and they involved me with examination updates by bringing me in to see everything.  My cat is going to feel so much better nust as I do now!! Thank you to the entire team!

I have had the best experience with them.
My cat had an upper respiratory infection and he was sneezing all the time with lots of mucus and some blood in it.
Another vet told us that there is a chance we would have to put him down.
I got him to Toronto Central Animal Clinic and the medicine they gave him , made him better within a week.
And we have not suffered with any issues since.
The doctors are very gentle with the pets and explain things nicely.

I only come to the clinic for grooming services, and I would follow the groomer - Carly - anywhere she went. Her incredible grooming services are the only reason we come to Toronto Central Animal Clinic, and we have been coming to Carly for over 3 years. We get our dog's nails trimmed by Carly every week, and her full groom every month. Carly does a fantastic job every single time. My dog is a poodle, so regular grooms are required, and Carly always treats my baby like the princess she is. Her work is always super clean and super cute - she does an amazing job of encapsulating the dog's personality in the cut itself and she's always open to the crazy poodle cuts we like to do. Most recently we hope to give my dog the BBL cut, but previous grooms included everything from a standard poodle cut (pom poms and all) to a specialty cut where we shape it to my dog's specific needs (de-floofing the inside of the ears to prevent ear infections, transitioning from a fluffy sanitary area to a clean shaven one - my dog doesn't like the breeze on her bits so we slowly shorten that area to get her used to it). Carly prioritizes the health and safety of the dogs, but doesn't compromise style unless she absolutely has to - and even then she will be super transparent about her process. She's very detail oriented and always finds things that would otherwise go unseen (a small scratch somewhere, a dry paw pad, etc) and is extremely helpful with providing suggestions for care if needed. We were able to get my extra-long nail diva down to a reasonable and healthier nail length thanks to Carly's care and insight. She really loves her job and it shows in how much her canine clients love her. My dog is a drama queen baby and she is VERY picky over who she lets handle her. She LOVES Carly and has never had issues with her - literally never. We actually had a groomer before Carly who my dog was fine with at first but eventually she became extremely uncomfortable with him and we had to switch groomers. I am so glad we found Carly because her skill level, care, and affordable prices cannot be matched. I know Carly's services extend beyond standard grooming (she does sedated grooms & cat grooming too) but we only come to Carly for regular nail trims and standard grooms (though her grooms are exceptional, not just standard). Though I have no experience with the doctors at this clinic, the vet techs and receptionist are also fantastic. Special shout out to the receptionist, she is incredible and so efficient! She is always on track with helping me make appointments for my dog as I am there every week for a nail trim, and I book my dog's grooms up to 4-5 months in advance sometimes. Everyone at the clinic is very welcoming and excited to see my dog every week, and I feel that my baby is in safe hands with them. If you're looking for a groomer I highly recommend Carly, I have tried quite a few groomers and Carly is by far the best.

I have been bringing my dog Ellie here for grooming with Carly for years.  I drive all the way from Brampton but the service and attention we receive is well worth the drive. Ellie suffers from severe anxiety, but Carly is phenomenal and very patient with her.   She takes her time and has built a strong rapport with Ellie.  If you’re looking for a professional and skilled groomer who is kind and compassionate, then I would highly recommend Carly.  I promise you will not be disappointed.
Amazing surgery on my cat. Amazing staff and pricing!

I brought my cat Haku to this clinic due to a very serious dental issue, and from the very first day I knew we were in the best hands. The care we received was truly exceptional — warm, respectful, and full of genuine kindness.

The veterinary team is not only highly professional, but deeply human. They supported us before, during, and after the surgery with incredible patience, explaining every detail — the good and the difficult — and always checking in with us before making any medical decision. At no point did we feel alone in the process. They treated Haku with so much love and attention that it still moves me to think about it.

I arrived feeling desperate, scared, and full of doubts, and instead I found people who put their hearts into what they do — people who genuinely prioritize the health and well-being of animals above anything else. People who welcome you kindly, who listen, who care, and who treat you with respect. Their ethics, dedication, and humanity deserve to be recognized.

Their prices are also more reasonable compared to other places, but above all, what truly stands out is their vocation and integrity.

I want to thank every single member of the team from the bottom of my heart. Thank you for loving animals the way you do. Thank you for your patience, your professionalism, and your respectful care. Thank you for taking care of Haku — and for taking care of me as well.

I don’t just recommend this clinic — I’m truly grateful for it.

❤️🐾

Rabbit owners, PLEASE do not bring your pets here

I need to warn other rabbit owners about what happened to my bunnies at this clinic, because it was honestly terrifying and completely avoidable.

My little sister brought in our two rabbits and she clearly told the staff ahead of time that one of our rabbits does not like being handled. Anyone who works with rabbits should understand how fragile they are and how important it is to adjust your handling.

They didn’t.

Instead, they kept both rabbits up on a high table. Every rabbit-savvy vet I’ve ever been to sits on the floor with a blanket specifically to prevent accidents. Rabbits are jumpy and can injure themselves incredibly easily. Mine never get handled on a table, ever.

While they were trimming nails, my bunny panicked (as my sister warned them he would) and the staff DROPPED him off the table onto the floor. He is a medically fragile rabbit. He just had a dental under sedation last week, he’s on medication for chronic middle ear disease, and he has a long history of sensitive health issues. Dropping him is not a small mistake. It’s dangerous.

Instead of immediately checking on him, they just kept going. Then they cut his quick and he started bleeding. They didn’t even tell her when he was bleeding. She overheard them asking for gauze and had to look herself to realize what was going on. She left the clinic crying, and not one person bothered to apologize to her. She called me immediately after in tears, even her uber driver was kinder, offered her tissues and asked if she was okay.

People who work with rabbits should know how delicate and sensitive they are. My bunny is on medication for chronic middle ear disease, he gets dentals procedures, and he’s had multiple expensive surgeries (PECA-BO surgery that costs thousands). I pay hundreds every couple months for his dentals alone. So no, money is not the issue. When I called the clinic afterward, the vet tech offered me a refund as if that would make up for dropping my medically fragile rabbit. I don’t care about the money. I care that my rabbit was mishandled and could have been seriously injured.

To make matters worse, the tech I spoke with on the phone kept interrupting me, blaming my rabbit, and acting defensive instead of showing even basic concern or accountability. Not once did he acknowledge how serious this could have been.

He tried to explain it by saying my bunny has black nails and was very jumpy, as if that somehow justified what happened. My regular vet has trimmed these same black nails for years without ever making him bleed, and if black nails are harder to see through, you can shine a light to see the quick. My bunny being jumpy is exactly why they should have done the nail trim on the floor, not on a high table where he could fall.

If you have rabbits or any other pets needing veterinary assistance, please, for their safety, do not bring them here. The staff clearly lacks proper training in handling rabbits, and their attitude afterward made everything even worse. I truly hope they take this experience as a wake-up call, but I will never bring my rabbits back.

Our first visit was to deal with fleas. The attention and care we got was appreciated. I noticed in this one visit a no-nonsense attitude towards their pet care that made me feel great. I mean that they focused on the pet concern and not the money they could make. We have since visited twice with both our cats, different vets, and still feel good about the visit. No price gouging. No unneeded treatments. All staff are very pleasant and helpful.
Staff was thoughtful and supportive during a very difficult decision to put my cat to sleep

The vet tech asked the same questions multiple times. The vet did the same checkup as the vet tech again. Barely could understand what they're saying with the heavy accents. Not a super great experience, not too comforting, given we're here for emergency visit. Lots of excessive tests. Couldn't clearly explain it either. Very not reassuring.

The place is nice though, compared to other emergency vet we've been to. The front desk lady is nice too
I have been going to this clinic for almost 4 years, both my cats are so comfortable with doctors handling them. All the staff is so amazing and accommodating.

Go anywhere else but here. This was the worst experience we've ever had with a vet. If you have money to throw away then head on over to this place. Had a cat several months back that needed an eye removed. This location was recommended by our vet. What a nightmare. Staff had no clue what they were doing right down to the "specialist". They were trying to fix the eye when it was very obvious it needed to be removed. Put a cone so large on the cat that there was no way on earth it would ever be able to eat. Ended up getting the procedure done finally for a fraction of the cost of this place elsewhere. I at least have to give one star as it won't allow no stars.

This clinic is truly amazing. When our senior dog passed away at another emergency clinic, our vet sent us a beautiful, thoughtful card of support — it meant so much to us.

Now we have a new puppy, and we couldn’t imagine entrusting her care to anyone else. The staff are compassionate, professional, and genuinely care about their patients and families.

Highly recommend!

I took my dog in to this location back in may for  vaccines and microchip 3 shots of vaccines/ microchip and a health check( which all the vet did was touching her up no test no nothing!) that in total costs me 700$.

I explained to the vet about my travelling to Asia, we will need a a health certificate signed by him, I asked for the price just so I know what to expect. AND WOW THE GUY TOLD ME ITS WILL COST ME 500$ for the certificate!!! Supposedly they needed to do a health check on her again and run some test, mind you this happened within a month cause our flight was due in June. When I asked what test do they need to run on her now since the first time I went in they didn’t do shit all on her. The guy couldn’t give me the exact answer to what test they going to run on her. IF YOU DONT HAVE TO DONT GO TO THIS LOCATION THE VET ( the India guy) ARE VERY UNPROFESSIONAL AND YOU CANT UNDERSTAND ONE WORD OUT OF HIS MOUTH.

I initially brought my 14 year old cat in for allergy symptoms, low appetite and increased water intake and after testing I was told she was "between 2 and 3 kidney disease". I was given appetite stimulant, omega 3 oil, and subcutaneous fluid that I had to administer myself.

I brought her back in two days later because she hadn't eaten or drank anything since returning from the vet. She was given more fluid and I was asked if I could give her antibiotics orally to which I replied no, she's easily agitated and I haven't had success in the past. Not only was I sent home with the oral antibiotic anyway, it was a children's tutti frutti flavoured antibiotic. Forcing medicine in her mouth was bad enough, but giving a carnivore 'tutti frutti' flavour? I can't imagine why a veterinary office would think to buy that.

After another two days and no food or water, I called back and was told my only option was hospitalization where they would put in an IV, do xrays, do an anema, etc. but I wasn't given a straight answer as to how much longer that would give her. Again, as an easily upset 14 year old cat, I came to the conclusion that euthanasia would be the best option. I figured if she continued not eating, she would only have a few more days and I didn't want her spending them alone at the vet. I scheduled the appointment with the receptionist but got a call from the veterinarian shortly after saying "No, please come pick up the pain medication, please bring her in, etc."
Not only was I at work and unable to go back that day, but I had already informed them of my decision.

At the euthanasia appointment, the veterinarian came in and started explaining the hospitalization process. I had to AGAIN tell him we weren't going through with that to which he replied "but she has so much energy" I assume he was referring to her anxious pacing. She had also not eaten in probably a week at this point. I was told they had a cat in the back that was only 4lb, had diabetes, had thyroid issues, was hooked up to an IV, and was 'doing fine' and was asked if I wanted to see the cat.
Not only did I find this unprofessional and upsetting, it seemed like an attempt to guilt me into hospitalizing her; mind you, that cat's condition is exactly what I wanted to avoid with mine.

After convincing the vet that I would still like to go through with the euthanasia, the tech came in with the consent form for hospitalization. At this point, I had already explicitly stated at least three times that I had no interest in putting my cat through that traumatic process.

We finally went through with it, where the vet switched between calling my cat 'it' and 'he' after seeing her two previous times.
Deciding to do euthanasia for quality of life is an extremely difficult decision on its own, but having a man basically plead me not to do it, especially when he's aware of her state is completely unprofessional and mean. After the third time, I can only imagine it was a last attempt at a money grab.

I’m sharing this again because my original review was removed, but fellow cat owners deserve to know what happened.

I brought my cats to this clinic several times and encountered a disturbing pattern of carelessness, miscommunication, and disrespect that ultimately made me lose all trust in their ability to provide care.

At my first visit, my kitten was limping. The clinic prescribed medication and clearly showed me the dosage pointing to the exact line on the syringe. I followed their instructions exactly, but the medication ran out early. When I called, they accused me of dosing incorrectly, until I realized the label they had provided was wrong and matched what I’d been shown. Even worse, when I checked the instructions the medication had a warning to not administer to cats under 6 months, and mine was only 4. That level of carelessness is not just unacceptable, it’s deadly and dangerous.

At a later appointment for booster shots, I came in a few months “late,” after being told to return in November. But the paperwork I was given said August. When I explained the mix-up, the vet laughed, blamed me, and brushed off the idea of an email or phone reminder, something every other clinic I’ve used has provided. He continuously and aggressively lectured me until I had to ask him to please stop talking from feeling extremely uncomfortable . I left unsettled and in tears.

Handling during both vaccination visits was also extremely rough and careless. My cats were hissing, crying, and visibly stressed, yet no one made any effort to ease their fear or treat them gently. It was clear the staff had little understanding of, or respect for how to work with cats. Three years later, after switching clinics and updating their vaccines again, the difference was staggering: my cats didn’t even flinch! They were handled so calmly and with love they didn’t realize they’d gotten shots. That’s how it should be, and it made the contrast with this clinic all the more distressing.

The final straw came when one of my cats started vomiting. I brought him in and they recommended X-rays. Dr. Badri told me every single one of his organs, heart, liver, kidneys, intestines, and stomach appeared swollen, possibly pointing to a serious or chronic condition. I was terrified. But he added that the bloodwork didn’t support that diagnosis. When I took a look I saw my other cats name on the file. I told him it was the wrong cat, but he insisted it was right. Then he opened another file, also wrong. Only after multiple failed attempts did he finally access the correct record. I was told to leave my cat for observation.

I spent the entire day crying, convinced I might lose my baby.

When I returned to pick him up, they handed him to me in the waiting room with no explanation, no update, nothing. I asked to speak to someone and the receptionist was clearly annoyed, rolled their eyes and got the vet. He came out asking what I wanted, I asked what was wrong with him and he muttered, “it might have been a stomach bug we don’t know” before walking away. No clarification. No reassurance. No apology for the earlier panic they caused. After everything, I was treated like an inconvenience for even asking. This later lead to huge issues with my insurance company as they believed he has a “pre-existing condition” that never existed.

Between the incorrect prescription, medical record mix-ups, misdiagnoses, harsh handling, and dismissive communication, I canceled their neutering appointments and never returned, out of fear a more serious mistake could cost their lives.

This clinic “might” be fine for dogs. But as a cat owner, I cannot recommend them. In my experience, they are not equipped to provide the careful, compassionate, and competent care cats need and deserve.

Do not recommend this animal clinical at all. My girlfriend brought both her cats here and had not one but 3 horrible experience. The nail on the coffin was when the “dr” was reading her results from the WRONG CAT. She had to tell him three times that was not her cat for him to make the same mistake again and again. She was going to do their neutering here but canceled because she did not trust her pets in their care. STAY AWAY!!! They even belittled her for missing a vaccination when they never sent out a reminder.
Fantastic service!

Toby, our 4-year old chihuahua, has been coming here since he was a puppy. The doctors and staff are so kind to him and us during our visits. As a follow up, they always call the following day to ensure he's doing well after his check up.

Thank you, Toronto Central Animal Clinic for keeping Toby in good health and up to date with his vaccinations.

Hello, my little Chi Dog who is 8 pounds woke up with an abscess tooth and his little face was very swollen. I had already taken him to 3 different vets and had 3 different quotes and $5000.00 to 7000.00 to remove all his teeth. Long story short I went to this vet on this sad day because I had made up my mind I was gonna put my dog down as he has other health issues as well but when I got there the vet was incredibly compassionate and took my boy for a fantastic price and removed all his teeth for me. They were all so wonderful and I'd highly recommend this vet to anyone. I'm still in shock about the price specifically and how wonderful Chippy and I were treated. Thank you all so very much. You saved my dogs life that day 🐕💙
Friendly and caring staff. They did a great job while neutering my dog.

If you had asked me a week ago, I would have said I loved our old vet clinic. Until my dog Penny developed a serious issue that was completely missed. Thankfully, I found Toronto Central Animal Clinic, and I honestly cannot thank them enough.

Even though they were fully booked and I wasn’t an existing client, they made time to see Penny when I needed help most. The care was thorough, kind, and professional. What really stood out was that the vet himself called the next day to check in on how she was doing. That kind of personal attention goes a long way, especially when you’re dealing with a sick pet.

When they did a wellness check at Toronto Central Animal Clinic, it was clear how much more thorough and ethical their approach is. Unlike my previous vet, where physical exams were based mostly on what the client thought was wrong, here they did a complete physical exam regardless of the presenting concern. They didn’t cherry pick what to look at — they assessed Penny’s health as a whole. That is exactly the kind of care every pet deserves.

This clinic clearly puts animals first and treats owners with respect and understanding. They are also open seven days a week, which brings a lot of peace of mind when emergencies happen.

Penny will now be receiving all her care at Toronto Central Animal Clinic. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy and compassionate vet, especially if you have a small dog and want a team that truly pays attention to the details.

My pet and I visited the clinic as a new patient recently. We had a great experience and the Vet Tech and Vet gave him his up to date vaccines other medication they felt was necessary. The price was reasonable. Will be bringing his Sister in soon for her check up. Hope to be long time patients.
Excelent experience and great attention for the workers and Vet.

I brought my cat in for what I clearly explained was constipation — all I needed was a liquid medication and her glands expressed. Unfortunately, this turned into a very frustrating and expensive experience.

From the beginning, the vet dismissed my concerns, saying he “didn’t feel anything” during the physical exam. We ended up going back and forth, and I felt like he was pushing on my emotional sensitivities as a pet owner who genuinely cares. I was advocating for my cat, and instead of being heard, I felt like I was being talked down to.

In the end, I was charged over $900 — just to be shown a picture of feces still in her stomach and a huge bill with a lot of unnecessary stress.

I understand vets need to be thorough, but this felt excessive, dismissive, and ultimately unhelpful for something I came in with clear expectations about. I left feeling upset, taken advantage of, and no closer to helping my cat.

Dr Badri and his team did a great job with removing a skin tag on my pug's eye lid at the end of 2024 and a successful teeth extraction and cleaning surgery back in May 2023. My boy is 11 years young now and I was very worried about putting him under. Dr. Badri and his team were professional, explained the process and showed me the operating table etc. Frankly, they were more caring than the other clinics that we were referred to. My pug Romeo had a nice and easy recovery and we are ready for summer fun. Thank you again Dr Badri. You and your team are highly appreciated.

Extremely friendly staff, open 7 days a week! The vets are caring & take the greatest of care with your furry friend. I'm so glad I switched to them. Their rates are also reasonable and will not upsell you.

For over 30 years, Dr. Badri has been our families vet doctor for our animals (cats and dogs). From in house visits,  to special care and helping up with putting our animals down, his clinic and staff are not only professional, but they care about all animals that enter their doors.
For 7 of those years, Dr. Badri was Our special Lunas doctor, she was a Bernese mountain and black lab mix with medical issues throughout her life ( she was adopted from the shelter at two months old with medical issues). The day we had to make the decision to put her down, Dr. Badri and his team stayed open for us to bring her to the downtown clinic on Parliament. It was one of the hardest days of our lives to say goodbye to someone so special to us. She was not only dog she was our family. She was handled with such care and compassion until her last breaths. We were able to get her cremated and get her paw stamp for memories. Luna was a very special part of our lives and because of his team, and amazing compassion towards our Luna, we were OK to let her go. We also received a card in the mail from the clinic with their condolences. Two years later, Dr. Badri knew how much we grieved our Luna and how much we cared for our animals, he helped us adopt a cockapoo and named her Baby. Dr. Badri and his team are very loving towards Baby every time she visits. She’s extremely excited for her check ups and special attention. we’ve never had any issues with any injections or any cleaning or any nail cutting. If it wasn’t for Dr. Badri, we wouldn’t have found out that our dog baby was extremely allergic to almost everything. we had blood and urine work a few months ago, and now she is on a special veterinarian food, and the sickness she had is gone. We had no idea she was allergic to almost every food. It is up to the owner to ask questions on how much things cost before they do treatments, and it’s up to the owner to make the right call to get pet insurance to help cover future issues that could happen with their animals. I can’t think Dr. Badri and his team enough for being so caring for our animals over all these years, and having the convenience of coming to the house to do Vet visits really makes a difference, especially when we don’t have time to go downtown to the clinic. I highly recommend Toronto Central Animal Clinic for your special animals. I also highly recommend pet Insurance. If you really love your animal this could help you in the future to save on any medical attention that may be needed. The Toronto Central animal clinic can help set you up with a pamphlet and the paperwork for your insurance. Thank you Dr. Badri for all your support all these years with our special babies and for taking the time out while we were grieving the ones we had to let go.

Horrible experience. Do not recommend, especially if you have a cat. I went for a simple check up and they don’t give you a break down of how much things cost, then just charge you at the end for everything. You have to ask if you want a breakdown of the costs.

I had to go back for a booster and they charged a full check up fee. They also kept referring to my cat as “it”, and didn’t give him any treats or proper care even though he was clearly agitated. They don’t explain what is happening or what they need to do as they’re doing it. Additionally, I had to wait 40minutes in the room after my scheduled appointment time until anyone came in. They wouldn’t let me take my cat out of the carrier and he hates it in there.

My cat was perfectly healthy before, and I ended up having to go to a 3rd appointment at another vet because he stopped eating after the 2nd time I came here due to anxiety. My vet bills have totalled up to $1k for a young HEALTHY CAT all because of the incompetency here.
We received prompt care and excellent service when we needed urgent care over this 2024 holiday season. Everything was clearly explained and I am grateful.
Very friendly and expert staff. Highly recommended.

Don’t bring your cats here!! The vests here have almost 0 experience with a bit complicated cat diseases. Badri misdiagnosed my cat who had diabetes. Eventually he’s saying either staying here for continuing treatments or go to emergency room for higher price. But he didn’t know about cats at all! Now my cat passed away. I was charged $2500 and he even declined to give refund. The vests like him are rampant  in Toronto as sadly the city leaves these “crimes” unattended.
I love this place. The vets are so friendly and great at their job.  They were very careful and attentive with my dog.  Also, the price is very fair, I spent around $130 for four vaccines.
Great staff and doctors are great to Milo and Yuna
The examination accompanying the vaccine comes in higher than the vaccines. But really God staff. Not overly expensive.

Have been taking my 13 year old dog there for just about a year now! With her being so old she has a several health issues and isn’t the nicest to strangers. Regardless the entire team treats her so kindly and gently. They are quick and explain all her health issues, test results, and treatment clearly to us and always listen to any questions we may have. Also their prices for food, medication and treatments are incredibly reasonable. I’m so grateful to have found them, and for taking such good care of my baby!

Avoid this clinic like the plague!! They lie and try to up charge you for unnecessary procedures. Be sure to record all conversations with them because they will refuse to show you camera footage to avoid getting caught in a lie <3

Could not recommend TCAC higher! Thank you TCAC for your expert care of my dog. Your compassion, willingness to help, and love for animals and humans alike is unparalleled. Thank you, thank you, thank you!
Extremely unprofessional I had a vaccine appointment there and they claimed they couldn’t find me in the system, also the place reeks of cat pee, find a new vet
